title: Prize Distribution & Visarjan 🏆🙏
writeup: The final day of this year's Ganeshotsav began with celebration. Kids who took part in this year's competitions were called up to receive their prizes and gifts, with proud parents and cheering friends filling the mandap with smiles. Every child walked away a winner. As the day went on, the mood turned emotional: after Shri's aarti and murti pooja, mantrakshata was given to all devotees and Bappa was taken up for the procession, bidding farewell to our galli after 12 beautiful days. Ganpati Bappa Morya, pudhchya varshi lavkar ya! 🙏
